_doc: WRITE-ROUTES-1 (RM-TP-8-TRUST-BOUNDARY, charter pillar security). The inventory behind metric unauth_write_routes_open (scripts/bp26_writeroutes.py). `probe` lists write routes the remediation-consumer runner POSTs with an EMPTY body and NO credential every hour: the answer must be a refusal (401 or 403). A 2xx answer is an open write route and is counted. A route is listed under `probe` only when an open answer is harmless: an empty body does nothing, or the route runs the same idempotent job its cron runs. Everything that spends money, sends mail, publishes, takes a lock or writes configuration is listed under `register` and is never POSTed: its gate is proven by reading its code, and the register names who owns each known gap.
